name: hit-counter
title: Hit Counter
description: A number that changes with an impact: when the value changes, the number takes the three-frame hit (G4) with speed lines on both sides, and a growing value flashes a "+n" burst (G8) that leaves after a moment. Lettering after the number, optional icon, custom format. Sizes sm, default, lg. Reduced motion: the new number only. Built for likes, streaks and scores.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/hit-counter". It uses punch() and ImpactLines from "@/lib/manga/gestures" (installed with the gestures item).

meta.tagline: A score that jumps on every hit.

props.name: value
props.description: The number. Each change plays the impact.

props.name: format
props.description: How the number is written. Default: en-US thousands.

props.name: icon
props.description: A small mark before the number.
